questions.prompt: How does Elasticsearch pick a document's shard?
Search is read-heavy. How does it scale read throughput?
options: Add replica shards; any copy can answer a search

questions.prompt: Put a distributed search's phases in order.
options: Query each shard for its top k ids and scores, then fetch the global top k documents

questions.prompt: With 50 shards, why are many searches slow even if each shard is slow only 1% of the time?
options: A search waits for its slowest shard: tail latency amplification

questions.prompt: Why is page 1,000 of 10 results expensive?
options: Every shard returns its top 10,010 and the coordinator sorts them all
